Callout.Name: Property Check
Callout.Message: Alarm activated at a property, no answer from the keyholder.
Callout.Advisory: No persons seen, no forced entry visible.

Script.Line: The alarm has been going forty minutes and nobody can reach the keyholder.
The front is secure. It is the back that worries me.
I am not going in through the back on my own.

Lines.Approach: Alarm has been going ten minutes and the keyholder is not answering. Could be nothing.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
